description.value:
Extensive practice with many weapons has paid off. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with all blasters; if already proficient, you can instead choose advantage on one blaster weapon damage roll per turn. You gain proficiency with all lightweapons; if already proficient, you can instead choose advantage on one lightweapon damage roll per turn. You gain proficiency with all vibroweapons; if already proficient, you can instead choose advantage on one vibroweapon damage roll per turn.

You can take this feat up to twice.
